# Roman Mednitzer

> Roman Mednitzer is a senior systems and platform engineer based in Vienna, Austria, with around ten years of production infrastructure experience across managed services, enterprise infrastructure and a regulated medical-device environment.

Canonical profile: https://rmednitzer.github.io/
Last reviewed: 2026-10-24.

## Professional scope

Senior Systems & Platform Engineer. His work combines technical requirements, hands-on infrastructure integration, operations, incident response, automation and verified recovery. It includes SOPs, ISMS documentation, business continuity and ISO/IEC 27001 audit preparation. This describes applied engineering and audit support, not auditor certification or legal qualifications.

He completed an Austrian IT vocational qualification in 2016. German is his native language; he uses English with full professional proficiency. Published employment entries are historical, not a statement of a current employer.

Technical interests in robotics, defence/mission systems, edge and high-performance computing are future directions, not claims of employment in those fields.

## Personal projects and lab

These are independent, AI-assisted projects outside employment. I use AI heavily for implementation, testing and documentation; I own the requirements, integration decisions, review and operational validation. They are separate from my professional infrastructure experience, not a claim of a software-development or ML-research career.

- [relay-shell](https://github.com/rmednitzer/relay-shell): MCP shell and SSH tooling with operation records and optional policy. Open by default, not a sandbox.
- [osint-workbench](https://github.com/rmednitzer/osint-workbench): self-hostable collection, evidence and retrieval workbench. Bounded workflows and a disposable Compose test environment; the full reference platform remains unfinished.

The private lab supports integration, migration and recovery experiments. Routine infrastructure operation uses deterministic automation, independent of external AI providers. Some deliberately complex workflows evaluate agent feedback handling and context retention. They do not represent a standard production process.

Hard science fiction and listening to industrial and electronic body music (EBM). [Spotify listening profile](https://open.spotify.com/user/31wopsyuay2v65wyqqngc47hv3py); not an artist profile.
